newsitem.title: USA: Wheelabrator sees 1997 EPS in $1.10-$1.15 range.
newsitem.headline: Wheelabrator sees 1997 EPS in $1.10-$1.15 range.

text.p: Wheelabrator Technologies Inc said Monday it anticipates earnings per share for 1997 will be in the range of $1.10 to $1.15.
"Earnings per share for 1998 and 1999 will also be correspondingly lower than previous estimates," said the firm, a majority-owned unit of WMX Technologies Inc.
In early February, Wheelabrator said it expected to earn $1.20 to $1.25 per share in 1997, compared to $0.65 in earnings from continuing operations in 1996.
Wheelabrator late last month said it was deferring indefinitely a plan to buy back shares in a Dutch auction.

In announcing its first quarter results on Monday, Wheelabrator added, "The company continues to anticipate cash flow from operations in 1997 of $220 million before approximately $100 million of tax payments relating to the sale of the water businesses and capital expenditures of $50 to $75 million."
Wheelabrator reported it earned $38.3 million in the first quarter, down from $40.6 million in the year-ago period.
